items.html: And with this will be resolved one difficulty that exists in these our words: how is it possible that the Malchut of Atzilut receives the light of the ZA of Atzilut, while the world of Beriah, which is inferior, receives light from the Bina of Atzilut? But the matter is that Beriah does not receive the light except through the external garment of all the garments of the Bina of Atzilut. And to this secret they alluded in the sixth Tikkun of the book of Tikkunim, folio 18, col. 2, in their saying that Ima dwells in the Throne.
